## Overview

All EO AI/ML Training materials in one place: slide decks (online and PDF), Jupyter notebooks (download or open directly in Google Colab).

- **Licence:** course text, slides and notebooks are licensed under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Third-party data and images keep their own terms.
- **Notebooks:** the "Open in Colab" buttons open the latest version from the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/anefelo/eo-ai-ml-training). Use **File → Save a copy in Drive** to keep your own edits.
- **PDFs:** the PDF exports of the slide decks may lag behind the online versions; when in doubt, use **View Online**.

---

## Cheat Sheets

Quick-reference material for Python, NumPy, GeoPandas, Rasterio, the Earth Engine Python API, Sentinel band specifications and spectral indices is on the [Cheat Sheets](cheatsheets.qmd) page. Use your browser's **Print → Save as PDF** for an offline copy.

## Additional Resources

### Recommended Reading

**Earth Observation:**
- [Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem documentation](https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu): finding and downloading Sentinel data, APIs
- [SNAP (Sentinel Application Platform)](https://step.esa.int/main/toolboxes/snap/): ESA's desktop toolbox for Sentinel-1/2 processing
- [SentiWiki: Sentinel-1](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/sentinel-1) and [SentiWiki: Sentinel-2](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/sentinel-2): official mission and product documentation
- [Remote Sensing Digital Image Analysis (Richards, Springer, 6th ed.)](https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-030-82327-6)

**Python for Geospatial:**
- [GeoPandas User Guide](https://geopandas.org/en/stable/getting_started.html)
- [Rasterio Quickstart](https://rasterio.readthedocs.io/en/latest/quickstart.html)
- [Geocomputation with Python](https://py.geocompx.org/) (free online book)
- [Geographic Data Science with Python](https://geographicdata.science/book/) (free online book)

**Google Earth Engine:**
- [Earth Engine Python installation and authentication](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/guides/python_install)
- [Earth Engine Community Tutorials](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/tutorials/community/explore)
- [Awesome Earth Engine](https://github.com/opengeos/Awesome-GEE)

**AI/ML for EO:**
- [Deep Learning for the Earth Sciences (Camps-Valls et al., Wiley)](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/Deep+Learning+for+the+Earth+Sciences%3A+A+Comprehensive+Approach+to+Remote+Sensing%2C+Climate+Science+and+Geosciences-p-9781119646143)
- [Fundamentals of Machine Learning for Predictive Data Analytics (Kelleher et al., MIT Press)](https://mitpress.mit.edu/9780262044691/)
- [Data-Centric AI Resource Hub](https://datacentricai.org/)

## Support & Feedback

### Having Issues?

- Check the [FAQ](faq.qmd) for common problems

### Report a Problem or Suggest an Improvement

Broken link, notebook error, or a factual mistake? Please open an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/anefelo/eo-ai-ml-training/issues) with the session or notebook name, or email [dimitris@anefelo.com](mailto:dimitris@anefelo.com).
